title: Momoi Airi — Don't Push Yourself〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: At The End of The Unraveled Thread

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, now that we seem to have our dance routine down, let's take a quick break and see how we did by checking the video.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Then, I'll be on recording duties today. Let's see... Open the camera up on my phone and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure about this?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? I seem to have moved to a different screen. What does this little square do...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Little square?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you might've opened the thing for uploading images and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, Minori, you're spot on.
Alright, you... The camera's the one next to that icon.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. Thank you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah... You did an amazing job on iHaz, but I guess you're back to being your usual self.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. But I know where it is now, so I should be fine in the future.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Speaking of which, iHaz airs pretty soon! Hehe. I can't wait to see it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our shoot went pretty well, so all that's left is to see how they edit it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I've gotta think they're gonna keep all of Shizuku's story in there. I mean, us appearing alongside Cheerful * Days was their big selling point.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Shizuku...?
Are you worried?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes... I believe I was able to say everything that I wanted to using my own words...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But how everyone takes what I said is entirely up to them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get how you feel...
But I think everything's gonna be okay.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, your story was just that moving.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: To my surprise, many were willing to accept me for who I really am.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As nervous as I was about doing this, their warmth helped me move forward one step at a time...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And now, like all those who are watching... I feel comfortable with me being this kind of idol.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I finally understand now that it's okay for me to just be myself.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course, we know that you experienced everything you spoke about firsthand and how hard things were back then...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But everyone will know that you're telling the truth when they see you tell your story.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!
It'll be fine, Shizuku! I'm sure of it!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All of you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know. Why don't we all have a group call together while watching iHaz?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! I fell asleep last time, so I wanna give it another go!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you were out like a light that time. We even heard you talk in your sleep.

rows.Speaker: Airi, Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha...
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, shall we start heading home?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come to think of it... There is one thing you mentioned while you were telling your story that made me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, there is?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The part about you being accepted as an idol and for who you are.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know how hard it was for you to have played Miss Perfect...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm being accepted for who I am now because our fans are so understanding, and because I had you and the others...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wouldn't have been able to make this happen on my own.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nonsense. You'll never be alone. We're in this together, aren't we?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you, Airi.
But I feel especially grateful for you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Remember the event we did at that elementary school...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I still managed to reach people...
Even back then.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You filled me with so much hope when I saw you play Happy Everyday.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And I was so happy when I saw that you were able to touch the hearts of so many people.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which is why I began asking myself, “What about me?” and, “Will people accept who I was when I was still in Cheerful * Days?”

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That actually sort of became the reason why I began looking back on what happened back then, but with a positive perspective.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I mean, Airi, you're the reason I was able to try so hard back then. You're also the reason why everyone accepts me for who I am now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
So, Airi, thank you.
You really are my favorite idol!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you... Stop it or you're gonna make me blush.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(What's gotten into you?
When did you become such an amazing person?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I mean, Shizuku, you've always been my...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Um, Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I...
I wanna do everything I can while we're in MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So my future self will be able to look back on this time and be proud of what I did.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Yes, that'd be wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you mind if I joined you on your journey?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Of course, silly.
Don't forget that you're also a valued member of MORE MORE JUMP!
